subject: Idea for Foreigner Restaurant
body:
Hi,

I came across Foreigner Restaurant and spent some time looking into the experience. What stood out most was the no-menu format — each course arrives as a reveal, and the whole meal is structured around discovery rather than expectation.

The restaurant already looks distinct, but I think the content could lean more into the pace and progression of the meal itself — the rhythm of the room between courses, the moment before each dish arrives — so the viewer feels what it is like to actually dine there, not just see the food.

I create luxury travel UGC built around that kind of experience-led storytelling. The concept I had for Foreigner would move from arrival through the final course, capturing the anticipation and atmosphere that makes the format feel immersive.

Happy to send over the full angle I had in mind for Foreigner Restaurant.

Best,
Malachi
